speaker: narrator
text: In six days, Microsoft, America's air traffic control, Chase bank and Apple all broke, and officials had to say: this is not an attack.

speaker: narrator
text: Thursday: Outlook and Teams go down worldwide.

speaker: narrator
text: Friday: the FAA, which runs air traffic control, stops every departing flight in America.

speaker: narrator
text: Only once before since nine eleven.

speaker: narrator
text: Chase says it's not a cyberattack.

speaker: narrator
text: Tuesday: iCloud, the App Store and Apple Pay stall.

speaker: narrator
text: Same day, a classified network at the NSA, America's spy agency, goes dark during routine maintenance.

speaker: narrator
text: America's intelligence chief, Jay Clayton, says: "This is not a cyberattack."

speaker: narrator
text: Fixing them means taking systems down and back up, and he says that's when things like this happen.

speaker: narrator
text: If one app or card is your only way to pay, one bad update stops you, like Apple's did.

speaker: narrator
text: Keep a second way to pay.
